scientific_setup.definition_i_total_electrons: n_e / n_H_total at slab centre (modern Lightweaver total electron density)
scientific_setup.definition_i_heinzel_analog: n_p / n_H_total at slab centre; closest analogue to Heinzel i because their H calculation neglects He ionization
scientific_setup.definition_f_total_electrons: n_e^2 / n_2 at slab centre, reported in cm^-3
scientific_setup.definition_f_heinzel_analog: n_p^2 / n_2 at slab centre; closest analogue to Heinzel f under their neutral-He electron-density treatment
